study.title: Evolution of a designed retro-aldolase leads to complete active site remodeling
study.enzyme_context: 2013 RA95 designed/evolved retro-aldolase series and source-defined lysine perturbations
study.scope: One published study; 12 source-defined constructs, four directly printed complete sequence strings plus eight derived mutant strings; 15 selected table rows, not 15 independent experiments. No biological registry admission, mechanism compilation, evidence-tier promotion or project experiment.
study.development_exposure: literature outcomes inspected for source annotation; not a frozen/unseen evaluation or design-success-rate sample

selection.included: All four RA95 main Table1 racemic rows and all eleven Supplementary Table2 rows, three kinetic columns each; all four Supplementary Figure5 sequences; table footnotes and endpoint-defining methods.
selection.excluded: Antibody comparator, enantiopure kinetics, E53A/malate arms, pKa, rate-acceleration columns, library-screening clones, structural coordinates and design success rates. No unreported clone is labeled negative.
selection.rationale: Resolve construct identity and background/endpoint-specific lysine perturbations, including weak residual and nondetected outcomes. Main Table1/SI Table1 duplicates are one source observation context, not replicated evidence.

sources.inspection: Full main article; Table1; Methods/S8, S11, S13, S15, S16; source discussion and inhibitor limitations.
All nine pages text-extracted; full pages2,3,5,9 visually inspected; table units, footnotes and complete sequences checked.

source_access.permissions: Article permissions allow academic-research viewing/download/text and data mining subject to publisher terms. Source bodies are retained locally, not redistributed. Study-scoped annotation is adjudicated under owner-authorized computational-development policy.
source_access.accounting_limit: Complete for the named scope from its first discovery request; counts actual downloaded bodies, including failed/error/challenge pages, not extracted ZIP member sizes. Unrelated inherited accounting gaps remain unchanged.

interpretation.permitted: In the explicitly fluorescence-marked RA95.5-5 background, K83M sharply reduces the reported efficiency column; K210M preserves its displayed efficiency but reduces k_cat. Engineered K83M/K210M derivatives of the evolved RA95.5 and RA95.5-5 backgrounds retain positive source-reported kinetic parameter values. RA95.0-K210M is reported nd in an unmarked table context, not a literal zero.
interpretation.design_relevance: Sensitivity to K83M/K210M substitution depends on the exact background and parameter. A catalytic-site label cannot be propagated by lineage alone: direct perturbation evidence here extends through RA95.5-5; RA95.5-8 has sequence/kinetic context but its site assignment is unresolved in this packet.
interpretation.sequence_identity_warning: SI Table1 footnote d states the 2013 RA95.0 differs from the earlier same-named construct by five surface-optimization mutations. Exact prior sequence was not acquired; do not merge by label.
interpretation.sequence_lineage_warning: Main text calls one RA95.5-5 change E53T; exact consecutive displayed sequences give S53T from RA95.5. RA95.5-8 reverses S43R and changes S178V. Preserve source wording and sequence-derived deltas separately.
interpretation.structure_limit: The paper reports deposited structures with a covalent mechanism-based diketone inhibitor, not reacting methodol or a transition state. This comparison acquires/maps no coordinate files and makes no productive-template or geometry-to-rate claim.
excluded_claims: positive double-mutant parameter values establish a third catalytic residue or an alternative mechanism
interpretation.mutation_causality_limit: Purified-mutant activity and parent inhibitor-adduct observations do not isolate chemical participation from mutation-induced structural effects. No mutant fold-control, mutant structure or elementary-step measurement is retained here.

source_conflicts.observation: KM column literally prints M while numeric kcat/KM relations imply a factor near 10^6 relative to reported efficiencies.
source_conflicts.decision: Retain literal numeric values and M unit, leave normalized KM null, and do not repair efficiency by calculation.

source_conflicts.source: SI Table1 page2 E53A racemic/S rows and RA95.5 S row
source_conflicts.observation: Displayed kcat, KM and efficiency do not agree arithmetically for the excluded E53A racemic/S rows and RA95.5 S row. The RA95.5 selectivity value 3.2 also differs from the displayed efficiency quotient 16/3.3 (approximately4.85).
source_conflicts.decision: Do not rely on these rows for E53A no-effect, enantioselectivity or comparative claims. They remain a source warning for future curation, not silent corrected data.

reconsideration.bespoke_code: No runtime or validator added. Case-specific sequence strings, mutation deltas, unit conflicts and assay eligibility are data.
reconsideration.reuse: Existing assay_id, parameter identity, missingness and source-reported quotient concepts are reused. New sequence provenance explicitly separates printed and reconstructed constructs. No repeat of the completed TKT/POX consumer test.
reconsideration.incumbent_value: The article already reports catalytic remodeling. Added value is a machine-readable constraint on name-only sequence joins and background/parameter-blind activity labels, with source conflicts retained. No measured curation-speed or comparative-accuracy advantage.
